decisions.reason: Permission to select any Teyron YouTube video does not change the requirement to select strong, impactful moments.
The expanded choice of YouTube video does not alter the requirement that each selected moment form a complete standalone lesson, story, or point.
Video-source selection has no effect on caption color, font, or text effects.
Permission to use any YouTube video does not change the clean-editing, animation, or transition standards.
The source choice does not change the required 45-to-60-second clip duration.
The source message only permits selection from any Teyron YouTube video and does not change the Lead Clipper pathway, training, compensation, or responsibilities.
The message concerns the current five-clip production batch, not the completed qualification method, clip count, success condition, or deadline.
Allowing any Teyron YouTube video as source material does not alter approval eligibility, Instagram destination, or the current publication schedule.
Source-video choice does not change the five-clip batch size, Google Drive submission method, folder access, or deadline.
Permission to choose any Teyron YouTube video does not change the monthly approved-clip quota, counting rule, cadence, or deferred lifecycle status.
The source-selection permission does not change who approves clips, which clips may be published, or how rejected clips are handled.
